title: You get what you pay for
text: You get what you pay for. The back had a hook and a lever so it can be hung out up or leaned, however they are opposite,  so to switch the way you use the frame - you have to flip the back. Also the hook is not centered.  I would have sent it back, but for the price,  I just used them.
